name: Mip-Grid
definition: A novel approach that integrates anti-aliasing techniques into grid-based representations for radiance fields, mitigating aliasing artifacts while maintaining fast training time by using a shared single-scale grid and generating multi-scale grids via convolution.
summary: Mip-Grid integrates anti-aliasing into grid-based radiance fields by generating multi-scale grids from a single base grid via learnable convolutions, avoiding heavy multisampling.
